messages:
Leila: Hey team — opened a small PR to clarify SOC2-friendly wording for evidence export and to add a region-aware de-identification snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

docs-bot: CI: docs build failed on staging — error in the python deid example (IndentationError at line 12).

Jordan: Thanks — I'll take it. Quick question: for the example, should we recommend pseudonymization (HMAC/salted ID) or show simple hashing? Legal tends to prefer hashing for examples but security prefers pseudonymization notes.

Mike: From legal: prefer to use "pseudonymization" in the wording and call out re-identification risk. For sample code, showing a salted HMAC is fine; include a note that salts/keys should be customer-managed (KMS/HSM).

Anne: Agree with Mike. For SOC2 phrasing I suggest a short sentence like: "Exported evidence may contain pseudonymized identifiers derived from customer-managed salts; re-identification requires access to those salts or keys." Please add a short pointer to key management best practices.

Jordan: Ok will update wording and replace the python snippet. New python snippet will use hmac + hashlib and a placeholder KMS call for salt:

```python
import hmac, hashlib
from kms import get_customer_salt  # pseudocode

salt = get_customer_salt(customer_id)
def pseudonymize(id_str):
    return hmac.new(salt, id_str.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
```

I'll also add a terser JS example. Is it okay to keep the KMS call as pseudocode?

Sam: That's fine. Also noticed the anchor link to the "region residency" section in the export guide is broken — I'll fix that in the same PR (link points to #data-residency-old).

Leila: Perfect. Jordan, ping here when CI passes and add a one-line changelog under Security (docs/changelog.md). Once green I'll merge.

Jordan: Pushed fixes and updated wording + changelog entry. CI is green: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/7890

docs-bot: CI: build passed on staging — all docs checks OK.

Sam: :thumbsup:

Leila: Thanks everyone — merging in 10 if no further comments.
